name: Suichuu no Karte ~Mizuchima Kaichuu Shinryoujo e Youkoso~
original_name: 水中のカルテ～みずちま海中診療所へようこそ～
source:
This is the Mizuchima Underwater Clinic, located beneath the ocean.
A mermaid doctor here can grant any wish with her magical medicine.

You, suffering from amnesia, awaken in this underwater clinic.

As the assistant to the clinic director, Mizuchima Komori, you will help solve the problems of a diverse group of patients.
translation:
这是位于海底的水间水下诊所。
这里的人鱼医生可以用她的神奇药物实现任何愿望。

患有失忆症的你在这个水下诊所中醒来。

作为诊所主任水内小森的助理，你将帮助解决不同患者群体的问题。
